notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) worked cleanly for homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and every category page - no client rendering block encountered, so no escalation to Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome was needed. robots.txt (checked first) has no Claude/anthropic-bot disallow, generic User-agent:* Allow:/ with only search/tearsheet/swatch/query-param disallows, none of which affected the fetched URLs. TREE: built from union of homepage mega-menu (Textiles and Home Accessories flyouts) plus https://www.sohohome.com/sitemap.xml (7312367 bytes, 2947 entries, filtered to 729 non-product URLs). Confirmed each leaf's own h1/canonical matched the requested slug before recording. QTY: read from the listing page's own 'View N products' control and the matching 'data-end-row="N"' attribute on the listing container - both agree on every page checked, used as the qty evidence. TEXTILE: recorded the 7 live nav subcategories under /textiles/ (Rugs, Bedding, Curtains, Cushions, Blankets/Throws/Bedspreads, Pool Towels/Robes/Bath, Table Linen) plus /textiles/personalisation (monogrammed pool towels and robes - genuine textile products, confirmed via product links on page, MEDIUM confidence because the category label itself is a service name not a product type). EXCLUDED from Textile: /textiles/sale (sale/collection page, banned by rule); /textiles/bath-linen (301-redirects to /textiles/sleepwear, canonical h1 'Robes & Sleepwear', data-end-row=0 - zero products currently listed and the category text mixes apparel items (pyjamas, slippers) with textile robes, so with nothing actually listed it was not forced into a zero-qty row); the sitemap-only rug/bedding/cushion style-facet pages (/abstract-rugs, /classic-rugs, /wool-rugs, /runners, /duvet-covers-and-fitted-sheets, /pillow-cases-and-protectors, /rectangular-cushions, /rustic-cushions etc.) - these are self-canonical but are attribute/style filters over the exact same product pool as /textiles/rugs, /textiles/bedding, /textiles/cushions; they do not appear in the mega-menu or in the Rugs/Bedding/Cushions page's own on-page sub-nav (verified no links to them from the rugs listing page), so counting them alongside the parent categories would double-count the same underlying products - treated as non-hierarchy duplicate/filter pages per the duplicate-prevention rule rather than distinct subcategories; fabric colourway swatch pages (/linen-bisque, /aubergine-velvet, /boucle-wool-and-mohair-sofas etc.) are upholstery-material filters for Furniture (sofas/armchairs), not standalone home-textile products. STORAGE: no dedicated storage/organisation taxonomy exists on this site. Checked full sitemap for basket/organiser/organizer/shelv/rack/trunk/chest/trolley/hamper/bin/container/crate - the only hits (entryway-consoles-and-shelving, home-office-shelving-and-sideboards) are explicitly under /furniture/ in the mega-menu, so Furniture per rule (site places them in a Furniture category). The one candidate node, /storage-and-decor ('Storage & Decor', 11 products via data-end-row=11), was inspected product-by-product (catchall dishes, ashtrays, a bowl, a tealight holder, an umbrella stand, a recycling bin, two magazine-rack colourways) - the great majority are purely decorative objects (ashtrays, catchalls, bowls, tealight holders) explicitly excluded by storage.md 24, with only 1-2 borderline storage-adjacent items (magazine racks) among 11; primary purpose of the page is decorative, not storage, so it was not recorded as a Storage row. storage_rows is therefore correctly empty - a genuine NO_CATEGORY result, not a missed search.
